book.name: Galatia
book.title: Kiristoos Yisa Tarjamonnante Kinin Yittsaa Bhawloos Galatia Eenana Kinin Thaapoono Warqanno

content: Ta inin giyayno yinne: Toydia naasa likka yinin dohonka, koymo wulsa imba yi dahaakaar, eedina waadadheadara yer harkaar edimehe.
Kidiar imbayn kina giyon wodanin yeskenka yekka gettsaynabee wottsaynabesa demente ki dahade.
Ogodettsi wodi akar naasi wonin dohonka, peen ko gilonka wodhayna wo maatade.
Ko dahaannaar Barjo yinin bhocchon wodan yeskaysaka, Naasa yintiam peendar ki nittsade. Kidiar maakalanka adhadhaa, yigginka wodhea ki dahade.
Ogoam yin kinin hayoono wodar dohon bazanam kashayse yigginka wodhayna woam dhacchanabee Barjo naana hayanabene.
Kisa naana yenin dohonna, yedi Barjoam “Baaba, Imbo” hamayse yenin eeloadettsi haysen yisa Naasasa Manpasinam yesa woylamindar ki nittsade.
Ogonante yedi Barjo naanane, keeda kaara os worshonatehe. Barjo naana ye daana, Barjosa toydina naanane.
Bhawloos Galatia Eenana Kinin Gaaloono
Kosa birayse Barjoam yenin dhesimon wodanka, pijadhinsa barjo maatimina yerrana worsho maatayse ye waadadhade.
Taaki Barjoam yedi dhesidine; kalon Barjo yeam dhesidine. Ta keeda igina kantaysa qolminabee pootiminabe peen ko yiggindar haminee maate? Tapir kena worsho maatana zagee zago?
Waana maataana rooronabee, arpinabee, wodanabee, levenabeam payya hayayse yeda gobshe.
Yena sun i qajadhaaw? Iam yenno goyno kurtunsa ko kurtunse.
Imbanaanato, inta yedettsi inin maatonna, yediar idettsi maatee hamayse yeam ida miske. Yedi yer kalaaka hattear iam geneetene.
Birayse Barjosa dhacchintan upsinam yena giyana baali inin haapoono burqadhayse yekal inin dohon wodanka konin dohonam dheseeda dhese.
Hamin ko dahaakaar isa burqono yeam galshea ko maataakaar, yedi iam toozadhayse jibbeetene. Barjosa gaanadettsi, pir Yesus Kiristoosdettsi hayayse iam ye tiyade.
Ogo wodanka yesa dohoono wozano hamote ko dahaa? Ogo wodanka ye damidianna, yesa aapinam hattear bulayse ina yenin imenam inta yena tarjayda tarje.
Ta keeda goninam yena inin giyonna yeam jibbea maatayse i haapadhaaw?
Waani eena yeam yidar maasana wocchimbhayse keda zage. Ko dahaannaar kenin zagayno payyanatehe; kedi yeam wokala edayse yidar bish maasana keda zage.
Ko dahaannaar yekal inin dohonka bish dayma, rooro wul yer payyana zagadhayna ye hanna payyane.
Isa naanato, Kiristoos yesa iinte kinin haapadhenka yekka pir iam yena adhima burqodettsi yedidine.
Taaki yembesana kinka daanabee ta isa dohon bhocchinam ookanabe i zagade. Harrna hambhidianna, yennon goynsa har haya iam konin zaskenam inin dhesaamonna ida gaale.
Aggarbee Saarabesa Kamsino
Yedi yigginsa demente daana zagayna eenato, yinda ina giyee: Yigginin giyenam qansattenu?
Abraamsa naana lamaa kenin dohondettsi, kalaa edon worshonsa naasa, lansoa pir worshotay hamon edonsa naasa kinin dohonam Mathaap Gazante thaapadhidine.
Ko dahaannaar edon worshonsa naasa eedin adhadhendettsi waan bhocchika ki adhadhade; worshotay hamon edonsa naasa Barjo “imayda ime” kinin hamon qaabeyn haydhenka ki adhadhade.
Ogono dhalqino kamsine. Igina maana lamaana mallana lamaanasa kamsine. Birayse Siina dhukandar imbhon mallansa kamsino Aggarne; kodi naanaam konin adhayno worshamonnane.
Aggar Areb peente dohon Siina dhukansa kamsine; kodi taaki dohon Yerusaalemdettsi koda maate. Harrna hambhidianna, Yerusaalembee kosa naanabe worshamonte ke dahade.
Cecinte dohoono Yerusaalem worshotay hammone; kodi wosa indane.
Harrna hambhidianna,

content.text: “Ya naasi adhayse dhesimino seekino edono, wozadhaa!
Ya adhiman burqon dhesimino, ililsayse ilataa!
geshoayn garon edonsa naana ke thoothade”

content: hamayse ko thaapadhade.
Imbanaanato, yedi Yisaaqdettsi Barjo “imayda ime” kinin hamon qaabeyn haydhenka adhadhaana naanane.
Ko dahaannaar ogo wodanka waan bhocchinka adhadhaa manpasinka adhadhaam kinin oytondettsi, taar ogodettsi ko maatade.
Ko dahaannaar Mathaap Gazano hamin ko giye? “Edon worshonbee naasabeam bulate oytaa. Harrna hambhidianna, edon worshonsa naasa worshotay hamon edonsa naasabesana kinka toydimehe” koda hame.
Ogonante imbanaanato, wodi worshotay hamon edonsa naanane, edon worshonsa naanatehe.
